title: Large language models for mental health diagnosis and treatment: a survey
core_idea: This survey examines how large language models can be applied to mental health by processing large textual data to identify behavioral patterns, support early detection, suggest personalized interventions, and improve access to mental health resources, while analyzing capabilities, limitations, and implementation challenges such as model-driven bias, privacy protection, and the need for clinical validation.
tldr: A systematic review exploring the potential of large language models to enhance early diagnosis, personalized treatment, therapeutic chatbots, and mental health education, and analyzing key challenges (bias, privacy, clinical evidence) and strategies for implementation.
